links.outcome: Review volume reduction and projected accuracy with selective deferral of unreliable LLM outputs to clinicians
links.effect: SCOUT reduced the volume of cases requiring human review by 45% to 83%, with projected final accuracy of 99.1% to 100.0% assuming expert correction of all flagged cases.

screen.practice: selective deferral of uncertain LLM outputs to clinician review
screen.reason: The study develops and retrospectively evaluates a deployment safeguard/guardrail framework (SCOUT) that measures uncertainty to selectively defer unreliable LLM predictions to clinicians rather than requiring review of all outputs.

primary.practice: selective deferral to clinician review via uncertainty triangulation guardrail
